description: gleam_rules.ml mixes four concerns: expression-tree helpers, ~37 live detectors spanning hallucinations/error-handling/style/complexity/security, the registration table all(), and analyze_module. The repo already has an established layout for this in the Crystal linter (crystal_rules_complexity/_security/_style/_quality/_exception_safety/... with crystal_rules.ml as the entry point). Mirror it for Gleam: gleam_rules_hallucinations.ml (wrong-language constructs, fake stdlib functions), gleam_rules_error_handling.ml (let assert, ignored/discarded results, assert density), gleam_rules_style.ml (redundant bool/case/let constructs, concat chains), gleam_rules_complexity.ml (nesting, pipeline length, tuple abuse), keeping gleam_rules.ml as the thin registration entry (all() + analyze_module). Do this after the fold refactor so files stay small from day one.
title: SRP: split gleam_rules.ml into thematic rule modules
